items.source: Create a transactional EntityManager proxy for the given EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: 为给定的 EntityManagerFactory 创建一个事务性 EntityManager 代理。

items.source: properties - the properties to be passed into the createEntityManager call (may be null)
items.translation: properties - 要传递给 createEntityManager 调用的属性（可为 null）
可共享事务 EntityManager 代理

items.source: emf - the EntityManagerFactory to obtain EntityManagers from as needed
items.translation: emf - 用于按需获取 EntityManager 的 EntityManagerFactory

items.source: entityManagerInterfaces - the interfaces to be implemented by the EntityManager. Allows the addition or specification of proprietary interfaces.
items.translation: entityManagerInterfaces - 由 EntityManager 实现的接口。允许添加或指定专有接口。
一个可共享的事务性 EntityManager 代理

items.source: For a behavioral definition of such a shared transactional EntityManager, see PersistenceContextType.TRANSACTION and its discussion in the JPA spec document. This is also the default being used for the annotation-based PersistenceContext.type().
items.translation: 对于此类共享事务性 EntityManager 的行为定义，请参阅 `PersistenceContextType.TRANSACTION` 及其在 JPA 规范文档中的讨论。这也是基于注解的 `PersistenceContext.type()` 默认使用的值。

items.source:
A shared EntityManager will behave just like an EntityManager fetched from
an application server's JNDI environment, as defined by the JPA specification.
It will delegate all calls to the current transactional EntityManager, if any;
otherwise it will fall back to a newly created EntityManager per operation.
items.translation: 共享的 EntityManager 的行为将与从应用程序服务器的 JNDI 环境中获取的 EntityManager 完全相同，正如 JPA 规范所定义的那样。如果有当前的事务性 EntityManager，它将把所有调用委托给该 EntityManager；否则，它将回退到为每个操作创建一个新的 EntityManager。

items.source: synchronizedWithTransaction - whether to automatically join ongoing transactions (according to the JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType rules)
items.translation: synchronizedWithTransaction - 是否根据 JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType 规则自动加入正在进行的交易。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rod Johnson, Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rod Johnson, Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Sam Brannen
